About us

A workshop built around Mercedes-Benz.

Silverstone Auto Service is a Mercedes-Benz and Jeep specialist in Msasa, Harare. We handle everything from Service A and B to timing, cylinder heads and suspension, working on the real cause rather than guessing.

Our motto says it well: the road to Mercedes excellence. If your car isn’t performing at its best, we have you covered.

House-call service

We bring the workshop to you.

Can’t get to Msasa? Our mechanics come to your home or office with the parts and tools to service your Mercedes where it’s parked.

  • Service and maintenance at your address
  • Genuine parts brought with us

Diagnostics

Warning light? Won’t start? We find out why.

We read the fault codes, then test and confirm the cause before replacing anything. Whether it’s a GLC 300 that won’t start, oil or water leaks, or a thermostat issue, you get a straight answer.

  • Full-system fault scan
  • Oil and water leak checks
  • No-start and electrical faults

Genuine parts

Original Mercedes-Benz parts and quality oils.

Engine work
